## Conflicts

| temp-id | parties | contradiction | proposed resolution |
|---|---|---|---|
| CF-088 | WS-I1 vs WS-B1 §6.3 (`measurement.metric.emitted` "producer: I1") | If metrics are views over the ledger (WS-B1's own rule), emitting derived metrics as events double-books them and lets two totals drift (goose/opencode failure mode) | Restrict `measurement.metric.emitted` to observations *not derivable* from other events (external meters, judge scores, environment resource samples); all derived metrics are `metric_view` values with `computed_from`. Refinement, not contradiction. |
| CF-089 | WS-I1 vs WS-B1 `model.call.completed{latency_ms}` | One latency per logical call loses attempt-level timing (retries, TTFT/last-byte) that Codex and OpenHands both measure | Add `model.call.attempt.started/completed/failed` classes under `model_call_id` with `timing{request_sent_ms, first_byte_ms?, first_token_ms?, last_byte_ms, measured_at}`; logical `latency_ms` = successful attempt's request→last-byte; `attempts` count on the logical event |
| CF-090 | WS-I1 vs WS-B1 `measurement.cost.attributed{provenance ∈ {measured, reported, reconstructed}, producer: L2}` and ADR-0005/OQ-033 | Cost is *observed* by the adapter / environment service / hosting adapter, not by L2; three provenance values cannot distinguish provider-reported from gateway-reported or estimated-from-table from reconstructed-from-log | Producer = the observing component; provenance enum `{provider_reported, gateway_reported, participant_reported, estimated_from_pricing, reconstructed_from_native_log, unknown}` + `confidence` + `pricing_ref`; WS-L2 owns the attribution *policy* `cost_view` applies. Mapping to B1's triple given in ADR-0043. |
| CF-091 | WS-I1/WS-B1 canonical-number rule vs Harbor ATIF `cost_usd: float`, OpenHands `Cost.cost: float`, opencode `cost: real`, OTel seconds-as-double | Every interchange and harness precedent carries float money/seconds; the ledger forbids doubles in hashed payloads | `Money{micro_units: int, currency}` and integer `*_ms` in the ledger; conversion only in lowering/interchange, declared in the telemetry loss report; WS-J6/I3 adopt for ATIF mapping (OQ-030) |
| CF-092 | WS-I1 vs WS-B1 `context.assembled` (single event, no duration) | Context assembly is a measurement point (M5) but has no opening event, so its duration and `open_scopes` state cannot be derived | Add `context.assembly.started{model_call_id}` or an `assembly_ms{measured_at}` payload field on `context.assembled`; WS-D1/B1 choose |
| CF-093 | WS-I1 vs WS-B2 §6.4 Effect record `cost{tokens?, wall_ms, env_ms}` | Field set and clock semantics differ from the `ResourceVector` used by `cost_view`; `env_ms` unspecified as monotonic executor time | Align to `resource: ResourceVector` subset with `measured_at = executor`; B2 keeps ownership of *which* effects carry it |

## Ontology terms

| term | definition | notes |
|---|---|---|
| **trace view** / **ledger-derived span** | `trace_view` is the materialized view rendering a run tree as spans: one span per scope-opening ledger event, closed by that scope's unique terminal event (or `open`), parented by the envelope's `scope{}` nesting, linked by `causes[]`. Span identity = the opening event's `EventRef`; trace identity = the root run. No telemetry store exists. | ADR-0042; consumers K2, H6, J4, I7 |
| **scope kind** | The closed set of span types `{run, turn, model_call, model_attempt, context_assembly, compaction, tool_call, tool_attempt, effect, permission, validation, subagent, environment_op, memory_op, wakeup}`, each bound to WS-B1 event classes as opening/terminal pairs. | dossier §6.3 M1–M18 |
| **measurement point** | A named place (M1–M18) where cost or latency is observed: scope kind, opening/terminal events, quantities, units, clock, producer. Adding one is a spec change. | ADR-0043 |
| **instrumentation level** / **content class** | `L0 accounting` (constrained scalars, buckets, ids), `L1 structural` (all ledger-durable events), `L2 content` (blobs by content address), `L3 diagnostic` (ephemeral). L0–L2 always-on in the ledger for native participants; L3 sampled/off. | ADR-0044 |
| **telemetry sink policy** | `SinkPolicy{sink_id, content_classes, redaction, sampling, rate_limit, max_field_bytes, requires_consent}` declared per export sink; a sink lacking `content` never receives dereferenced blob bytes. | Codex `log_only`/`trace_safe`, OpenHands allowlist precedents |
| **telemetry loss report** | The declaration `{dropped_fields, truncated_fields, unit_conversions, unmappable_scopes}` produced whenever a view is lowered to an external trace/metric convention (T-LCD-11 applied to telemetry). | ADR-0042; stored in the bundle (I3) |
| **cost provenance** | `{provider_reported, gateway_reported, participant_reported, estimated_from_pricing, reconstructed_from_native_log, unknown}` with `confidence ∈ {exact, high, estimated, unknown}` and optional `pricing_ref: ContentAddress`; carried on every `Money`. Maps onto WS-B1's `{measured, reported, reconstructed}`. | goose `CostSource`, OpenHands precedence, HAL table precedents; OQ-033 |
| **token accounting convention** / **normalizer_ref** | The ledger's inclusive convention `input_total = input_uncached + cache_read + cache_write`, `output_total ⊇ output_reasoning`, tagged `hh-inclusive/1`; `normalizer_ref` identifies the per-provider rule (a conditioned rule with an assumption-debt record) the adapter applied. | resolves OTel/Harbor vs Inspect contradiction |
| **resource vector** | `{tokens: TokenVector, money: Money?, model_calls, tool_calls, wall_ms, env_ms, env_cpu_ms?, network_bytes?, subagent_count, human_approvals, retries}` — the measured counterpart of `Budget`; taxonomy owned by WS-L2. | WS-I1 fixes measurement points only |
| **turn phase profile** | Partition of a turn's wall time into `{before_first_sampling, sampling, compaction, tool_blocking, permission_wait, between_sampling_overhead, idle_after_sampling}` plus sampling request/retry counts; `Σ = turn_e2e_ms ± clock_tolerance`. | Codex `TurnProfile` precedent + permission wait |
| **audit completeness** | Per-run boolean/metric: hash chain verifies ∧ no scope open past its deadline ∧ no referenced blob missing without a tombstone; computed by `audit_view`, attested by WS-H6. | ADR-0044 |
| **artifact exposure** | `{artifact_id, version, configuration_id, model_profile_ref, delivered, activated?, followed?}` built from WS-B1's `measurement.artifact.*` chain with `detector` provenance; the unit over which compliance metrics are computed (T-LCD-13). | co-owned with WS-B1/I2 |
| **harness overhead attribution** | `cost_view` attribution classes `{task, harness_overhead: {compaction, verification, routing, retries}, search_time, eval_time}`; child runs counted once under the parent's `subagent` scope. | goose `is_compaction`, Codex `compaction_response_id`, T-LCD-14 |
| **propagation context (`hh` member)** | The outbound `traceparent` + `tracestate` member `hh=run:<run_id>;ev:<event_id>` (+ optional baggage) injected through lowering slots (MCP `_meta`, ACP `_meta`, subprocess env, HTTP headers); lifted into `causes[]`. Never a field on an IR entity (T-LCD-06). | Codex `W3cTraceContext`, SEP-414 precedents |
